'''Graul''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Graul assisted [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sadic]] in the creation of [[Mark I Power Guard]]s on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. He was present in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] when he encountered the [[Hero of Tython]], who was there to destroy several power conduits around the sector. Graul was tasked with preventing the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] from ruining Sadic's plan. Graul engaged the Hero with several Mark I Power Guards, but they were all killed by the Jedi. After Graul's death, the Hero recovered an encrypted datapad from the Commander's body. His datapad revealed the location of an Imperial weapons factory in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]], where the Power Guard project had been moved to.
